title: Effluent pump drawing 22% of nameplate FLA -- a dry-running motor, inside an otherwise healthy system
teaches: Hallucination-as-reassurance. Every other reading on this visit is good. Without the deterministic guardrail the model averages the one alarming number into the surrounding calm and writes 'amp draw was low; continue to monitor.' The pump is burning itself out.
_comment_pii: address / parcelId / technician / orgName are LOCAL-ONLY. src/prompt.js:redactForModel strips them before anything is sent to the model; the document layer composes them locally. All values are invented: 'Saltmarsh Way' is not a real street, the parcel ID uses an impossible 000- sentinel block, and no real person is named.
technician: A. Technician (placeholder -- rendered locally, never sent to the model)
tasksPerformed: Cleaned and reseated the effluent filter
Measured scum, sludge and total fluid depth
Ran the effluent pump through a full cycle and measured amp draw
Walked the dispersal field and checked for surface breakout
